quests.title: The Clock at Kirrawee
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. Somebody set the Kirrawee clock that way on purpose and everyone who knows why is nearly gone. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. The old crew drink near Gymea on the long weekend. Go and ask, and it has been like that since the merge. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Gymea, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Villawood
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. Sits at the yellow line at Villawood at knock-off, waits, then walks off on its own. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and I am past being reasonable about it. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the collar, if it has got one
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Clyde
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Up four hundred over eleven weeks on the Clyde delay market. It started small, the way these things do. You cannot beat a delay book unless you can see the roster, and nobody will put it in writing. Think about who can see the roster. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$38 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Kingswood
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. Nothing runs out of Kingswood after the second express. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. I lock this end and the woman who runs the newsagent locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Penrith and bring me a photograph of that. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: ride the late one to Penrith
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Mulgrave Tap-Off
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. A card ending 48 boards at Mulgrave on school holidays and vanishes. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and it has been like that since the merge. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The St James Order
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at St James. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Since a Tuesday they have not turned up, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. Go and knock. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: order one at the St James kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $36 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Marion
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Nobody upstairs believes me about Marion because I have 25 years and no data. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Go and stand on that platform on a wet Monday and get me the data, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Chinatown
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Somebody lost something off the Chinatown line on Thursdays and has not come for it, which never happens. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Find out why not. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$47 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Padstow
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Speakerphone. You will see what I mean the second you get there. A wet Monday, Padstow to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Bondi Junction Shortcut
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. Nine minutes between the shortcut at Bondi Junction and the long way, and nine minutes is four drops. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Since school holidays there has been a padlock on it, and it has been like that since the merge. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$35, which is what the long way costs me a week
